note: 50-storey, 200 m residential tower at The Ellinikon by Athens-listed Lamda Development; the frame topped out in mid-2026, works have moved to MEP and interiors and Lamda targets handover to owners in summer 2027. All roughly 170 apartments were pre-sold (press reports 170 to 173 units, average about EUR 3.66m and EUR 14,000/m2 per Axia data), so there is no primary stock left. No permit number or deposit protection is published. (checked 1 Nov 2026)
